# Subway Seat for dunst

Notifications on the raised paper ground. Low urgency is quiet, normal has a denim frame and a gold progress bar, critical has an orange frame. It's a drop-in, which dunst only reads next to a dunstrc of your own: if `~/.config/dunst/dunstrc` doesn't exist, copy `/etc/xdg/dunst/dunstrc` there.

[dunst](https://dunst-project.org) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/dunst/) · Needs dunst 1.8+

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.conf`](subway-seat.conf) | `~/.config/dunst/dunstrc.d/subway-seat.conf` |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.conf`](subway-seat-tunnel.conf) | `~/.config/dunst/dunstrc.d/subway-seat-tunnel.conf` |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.conf`](subway-seat-enamel.conf) | `~/.config/dunst/dunstrc.d/subway-seat-enamel.conf` |

## Turn it on

In a shell (dunst 1.12+ reloads; older versions restart):

```sh
dunstctl reload   # or: killall dunst
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.config/dunst/dunstrc.d/subway-seat.conf`.
- Delete `~/.config/dunst/dunstrc.d/subway-seat-tunnel.conf`.
- Delete `~/.config/dunst/dunstrc.d/subway-seat-enamel.conf`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.
